objective: Move deliberate shake to voice control, add supported back-tap shortcut and source-location fallback, connect voice to env-configured n8n
acceptance_criteria: Strong repeated motion with cooldown toggles voice instead of GPS
Motion resources and speech sessions clean up safely
Back-tap uses OS shortcut support, never an accelerometer imitation
Location action sets Source and preserves destination, with permission/reverse-geocode failure handling
n8n endpoint comes from environment, actual contract probed without private data
Original/protected files remain unchanged; strict checks and regression tests pass

decision.action: Extend the existing sensor/speech adapters and map RPC, with an OS deep-link location shortcut
evidence: Existing shake triggers on one accelerometer spike and sets GPS
Speech adapter already handles unavailable native module in Expo Go
n8n service offers customWebhookUrl and structured command/chat payloads
iOS Back Tap can invoke an installed shortcut but is not exposed as a browser event
decision.risk: Permission prompts, duplicate gestures, stale voice/GPS results
